question: Identify the step that is NOT a part of decomposition.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Soil erosion.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Decomposition** literally means **"to break down."**
 
• Decomposition is a **metabolic process** that consumes **complex chemicals** as raw materials, processes them, and then transforms them into **simpler compounds.**
 
• **Decomposers,** which include **bacteria, fungi, **and a few other microorganisms, are those who start the **decomposition process.**
 
• To stay alive, they **consume dead organisms.**
 
• **Dead and decaying animals **and plants are used as the raw materials for the **breakdown process.**
 
• That results in the production of **nutrients, carbon dioxide, water,** and other things.
 
• Raw elements like** dead plants, animals**, and their remains are referred to as** detritus.**
 
• These microbes, collectively referred to as** saprophytes**, then digest this debris.
 
 
• Nutrients are released into the water and soak into the soil through a process called **leaching.** 
 
• The process of converting complicated molecules into simpler ones is known as **catabolism. **
 
• **Humification** is the process by which dark-colored humus develops on the soil.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Soil erosion:**

 
 
• ​The **wearing away of the topsoil** layer is known as soil erosion.
 
• It contributes to** soil degradation.**
 
• The dynamic action of **erosive agents, **such as **water, ice, snow, air, plants,** and animals, is what drives this natural process.
 
• It has caused a **sharp rise in river pollutants and sedimentation**, clogging up the water bodies and causing a fall in the number of **aquatic creatures.**
 
• **Degraded areas** lose their ability to** hold water**, which causes floods.
